input_activity.source: Explicit mean-activity assumption; not sampled workload switching

mean_conductance.source: Explicit uniform cell-code approximation; no conductance measurements

driver_idle_fraction.source: Engineering standby allowance; borrowed 5% scale from New_Architecture!U40, not a measured driver leakage

adc_idle_fraction.source: User-selected engineering allowance: 25% of the cited ADC native active power during nonconverting lane time; not a measured standby value or a NeuroSim-derived fraction.
adc_idle_fraction.description: ADC standby assumed at 25% of published active power during nonconverting lane time; engineering estimate, not measured idle power.

analog_supply_v.source: New_Architecture!O40/O52 amplifier bias formulas; thick-oxide proxy retained at source voltage

frontend_bias_ua.source: New_Architecture!O40 literal current, reused as a conditioning amplifier proxy

reference_bias_mw.source: New_Architecture!Q56 literal 2*0.26 shared bias, used once per core

layout_area_fraction.source: New_Architecture!D97 area margin, treated as a floorplanning allowance

clock_wire_power_fraction.source: Explicit engineering allowance for physical distribution; not a synthesis or layout result

boundary: Approximate preloaded-core costs. Source-specific operating points, ideal analog correctness and engineering allowances. No calibrated full-chip PPA.
excluded: Host I/O, Go rules and metadata
Package, pads, ESD and off-chip memory
